character.name: Mitm
character.description: This unit can designate one <@ba.kw>Tactical Point</> within attack range to call Reinforcements; ATK is increased to 150% when attacking enemies blocked by Reinforcements

character.itemDesc: The adviser of the Sarkaz has only his own counsel to keep when he runs into a difficult problem himself.
